area: the five NYC boroughs (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, Staten Island)

publications.name: The Infatuation
publications.look_for: the "NYC's New Restaurant Openings" page (grouped by month; usually the best source) and the New York Hit List

publications.name: Eater NY
publications.look_for: the "new restaurant openings to know" roundup and the Manhattan/Brooklyn heatmaps. ny.eater.com often blocks fetching; its posts are syndicated on Yahoo

publications.name: Grub Street
publications.look_for: restaurant openings roundups. grubstreet.com often blocks fetching; skip it if no readable copy exists

publications.name: Time Out New York
publications.look_for: the monthly "best new restaurants in NYC" list (no regular openings feed anymore)

publications.name: Resy Editorial
publications.look_for: the Resy Hit List and "new on Resy" for New York
